description: Find pieces for sale on Port66 (authenticated luxury, streetwear and collectibles). Use this first: every other listing tool needs an `id` from these results. Returns up to `limit` active listings, each with id, title, brand, category, condition, size, price in USD (null when the seller only takes offers), whether it accepts offers, shipping, authenticity level, seller, image_url and a port66.xyz url. All filters are optional; with none, returns the newest listings. Multi-word queries match listings containing those words, so 'kaws elmo' finds 'KAWS x Sesame Street Elmo'.

brand.description: Only listings from this brand, e.g. 'Miu Miu' or 'Supreme'. Partial, case-insensitive match.

category.description: Only listings in this category, e.g. 'Bags', 'Sneakers' or 'Collectibles'.

limit.description: How many listings to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

max_price.description: Highest listed price to include, in US dollars.

min_price.description: Lowest listed price to include, in US dollars.

query.description: Words to look for in the listing title, e.g. 'KAWS figure' or 'Chrome Hearts tee'. One to three words work best.

name: search_listings
title: Search Port66
